messages:
Alice M.: Hey team — Horizon (finance) is asking for a short POC. They want a dedicated GPU pool (not hosted) for model evals. Mixed SKUs: H100 for heavy throughput and A10 for cheaper burst. Region: us-west1. Can we do a 3-day reserved POC? Need rough cost, provisioning ETA, and VPC peering/CIDR guidance. Also they asked about temporary API keys for dev testing.

Ben K.: @Alice M. thanks — a few quick q's: expected concurrent requests / RPS? typical sequence lengths? do they need persistent NVMe scratch? any egress/data residency constraints beyond us-west1?

Alice M.: Good call. They expect ~120 concurrent sessions, peak ~200 RPS, avg seq 512 tokens but evals hit 2k occasionally. No persistent NVMe, but logs must stay in region. Egress to their analytics in us-west2 is ok.

Carla S.: @Ben K. @Alice M. ok. For mixed H100 + A10 pool we generally provision separate node groups and route by model size. Lead time: ~48-72 hours once quotas are confirmed and CIDR are provided. We need an explicit /24 CIDR for peering or their side for AWS VPC peering (example: 10.50.20.0/24). Can also do Private (VPC) with customer-managed NAT.

Ben K.: Cost roughball: H100 nodes (on-demand equivalent) are pricey. For a 7-node H100 group + 8 A10 nodes for bursts, estimate ~ $12k-$18k/day fully running. For a 3-day POC we can offer a short NRE discount — I'll put a ballpark quote and ask finance to confirm.

Evan L.: tagging infra-ops: what about quotas in us-west1? any spare H100 capacity this week?

Carla S.: @Evan L. we have limited H100 capacity this week. Could start with 4 H100 + 6 A10 and enable burst autoscale (if they accept slightly higher latency on burst). If Horizon needs strict latency SLA we'll need reserved capacity increase (longer lead time).

Alice M.: Horizon also has an internal security review — they asked about API key TTLs for dev keys and whether we can rotate keys automatically. They also need an entry in the security questionnaire about data at rest encryption.

Ben K.: We can issue scoped API keys with a 72-hour TTL for dev, and rotation hooks via our Console/CLI. For dedicated pools keys can be scoped to tenant and model routes. Data at rest is AES-256 by default; add that to the questionnaire response.

Carla S.: For the provisioning request I'll need: customer CIDR for peering, contact for their network team, list of models to pin (so we can pre-pull weights), and an approved billing contact. Also confirm whether they'd accept a mixed-sku routing policy: small models -> A10, large -> H100.

Alice M.: I'll get the CIDR and network contact today. Models to pin: gpt-3.5-large (quantized) and a custom 30B fine-tune for H100. Billing contact: accounting@horizon.io.

InfraBot: pool-request-created #REQ-7219 (status: provisioning_requested)

Carla S.: Created internal ticket REQ-7219. Next steps: we run quota check, schedule HW, prepare VPC peering docs. ETA: provisional pool in ~48h with the 4H100+6A10 plan; full 7+8 plan subject to quota.

Ben K.: I'll draft the POC quote and a short statement of work (SOW) with discount options. Also adding a line: temporary dev keys expire 72h; production keys require SSO + rotation policy.

Alice M.: Perfect. I'll update Horizon and funnel their network contact to Carla. One ask from them: can we pre-warm the KV cache for the 30B model?

Carla S.: Yes — we can pre-warm with a synthetic prompt set. Add pre-warm time to SOW (~2 hours) and we'll include it in the provisioning window.

Ben K.: Summary for Horizon reply (short): 1) We can do a mixed H100+A10 dedicated POC starting in ~48h (subject to quotas). 2) Temporary dev API keys (72h TTL) available. 3) Need CIDR + network contact + models to pin + billing contact to proceed. 4) Estimated cost for initial 4H100+6A10 config: ~$6k-$9k/day; full size estimate to follow.

Alice M.: Thanks all — will send that now and loop in Horizon's network ops. Follow-up thread if we hit quota issues. :thumbsup:
